description: This file contains a ValidationService class responsible for executing validation runs, generating validation reports, and managing validation data in a database. It includes methods for running validations, checking data conformity, fetching reports, and listing validation runs.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service class for managing data validation processes, report generation, and database interactions related to validation runs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_validation( self, submission_id: str, validation_profile: str = "baseline", actor_user_id: str = "system", actor_role: str = "system", correlation_id: str = "", )
methods.description: Executes a validation process for a given submission, performs various checks, generates reports, and updates database records accordingly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_schema_conformance(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a schema conformance check, mainly verifying if the dataset hash is a placeholder.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_freshness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a dataset freshness check (stub implementation with fixed values).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _check_completeness(self, package: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a data completeness check (stub implementation with fixed values).

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report based on validation run ID, loading the report from stored JSON file if available.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_validation_runs(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a specific submission, ordered by creation time.
